# `log1p`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
log1p(expr)
```

Returns log(1 + `expr`).

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- log1p, example 1
> SELECT log1p(0);
0.0
```
